messages:
raj-support: Escalation from AcmeMaps — APAC p99 latency spiked ~10:15 UTC, users report ~400-600ms vs expected ~80ms. Customer says requests are being routed to us-east. Can someone triage?
acme-cs: Confirming — we observed a jump starting 10:12 UTC. Traces show an extra hop to us-east-1 for model inference, which adds ~300ms. Affects ap-sg and ap-nz zones.
trace-bot: Sampled trace (trimmed):
```
root -> route-eval (ap-sg) -> policy-check: preferred_region=ap-sg -> route-lookup: model=rwkv-large-v2 -> backend-assignment: fallback=us-east-1 (reason: shard-missing) -> proxy-us-east-1 -> model-runtime -> response
latencies: route-lookup 12ms | proxy-us-east-1 310ms | model-runtime 45ms
```
liz-sre: Hmm fallback reason 'shard-missing' is odd — we shouldn't be missing shards in ap-sg for rwkv-large-v2. Any recent catalog changes?
john-eng: I just searched the model-catalog logs — there was a deploy 10:04 UTC that modified region mappings for rwkv-large-v2. It accidentally removed the ap-sg placement tag for the v2 quantized shard. route-eval therefore chose a global fallback policy which sends to us-east. Pushing a rollback patch now.
emma-ops: Rolling back model-catalog deploy to 2026-03-12-7f3b9 (started 10:22 UTC). I'm also kicking a cache invalidation for route tables in ap zone. Will report when done.
trace-bot: Quick check: route-cache entries pre-rollback: rwkv-large-v2 -> placements:[us-east-1]. Post-rollback should repopulate placements:[ap-sg, ap-nz, us-east-1].
liz-sre: Repro steps for validation: 1) run curl from ap-sg test runner: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\" -H \"x-preferred-region: ap-sg\" \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate\" -d '{"model":"rwkv-large-v2","prompt":"ping"}' -v` 2) check X-Redwood-Routed-Region header in response. Expect ap-sg. 3) capture trace id from X-Trace-ID and dump via `redwood-trace get <id>`
acme-cs: Running the repro now from our Singapore runner — initial request before rollback: X-Redwood-Routed-Region: us-east-1, p99 ~520ms. Trying again...
emma-ops: Rollback finished 10:31 UTC, route cache invalidated in ap-sg. Waiting for propagation (~30s).
acme-cs: New response: X-Redwood-Routed-Region: ap-sg, p99 ~85ms. Looks good on our end. Thanks! :thumbsup:
john-eng: Root cause summary for ticket: model-catalog deploy removed placement tag for quantized shard in AP region causing route-eval to pick global fallback (us-east) per fallback policy. Mitigations: add CI check to prevent removal of all region placements for serving shards, and a route-eval alert when fallback_rate_by_region > 1% in 5m.
liz-sre: I'll file the CAR and add the alert. Also recommend a short runbook entry: how to verify placement tags and manually re-add if a bad deploy slips.
raj-support: Thanks team — I'll update the customer with the fix and include repro steps + trace snippet. Closing after customer confirms in 1 hour.
